features.notes: Native plugin path exists; iOS behavior can vary with OS policy/runtime conditions.
Uses browser SpeechRecognition API; support varies by WebView/engine.
Fallbacks exist; iOS file share/download behavior depends on platform/browser capabilities.
Current sync behavior is foreground/interval based, not OS background-sync resilient.
Storage APIs are available across targets, with quota/eviction differences.
PWA/Capacitor use ui-feedback.js showToast/notifySuccess; React Native uses ToastProvider (non-blocking save feedback).
Vibration API on web where available; native haptics on RN selections/saves; gracefully no-ops when unsupported.
